data.description:
Linear is a design-focused issue-tracking and project management platform tailored for modern software development teams. Founded in 2019 by Karri Saarinen, Tuomas Artman, and Jori Lallo, the company aims to enhance efficiency and speed in project management. Operating as a remote-first organization, Linear is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with additional hubs in New York City and Helsinki, Finland.
